tasks.name: nav_frame_repro
tasks.text: CONTEXT (measured, see docs/evidence/nightly_20261030/frame_root_cause/README.md and probe_output.txt): digital_twin/ws/src/x2_twin_sim/x2_twin_sim/world.py map_to_sim places walls assuming the pelvis spawns at sim (0,0) yaw 0. geometry.FrameAligner (used only by plant/hal_plant_node.py HalPlantNode) anchors the map pose on the FIRST HAL sample the plant receives. After stand-up the robot settles at yaw +0.108 rad, xy (+0.0455,-0.0174), so a late first sample rotates the nav frame by about -0.108 rad about the start relative to the walls (0.69-0.73 m at the end of a ~7 m path). SCOPE: only this twin frame-anchor mismatch. Do NOT touch P20, localization, controller, costmap, goal tolerances, footprint or safety logic. No artificial offsets. Work ONLY inside your worktree; never contact any robot or network service. TASK 1 (REPRODUCE): add the OFFLINE pytest file digital_twin/ws/src/x2_twin_sim/test/test_frame_anchor.py using only x2_twin_sim.geometry (FrameAligner, compose, inverse, planar_pose) and x2_twin_sim.world.map_to_sim (pure python, no rclpy). Tests: (1) test_first_sample_anchor_rotates_nav_frame_vs_world_contract: spawn pose is world (0,0,0); the first sample seen is the settled pose (0.0455,-0.0174,0.1082); with start=(-7.885,12.966,0.0), show that FrameAligner(start).align(world_pose) for a world point 7 m ahead differs from the world-contract map point start (+) world_pose by >= 0.6 m, and the implied rotation is about -0.108 rad (documents CURRENT behaviour; must pass). (2) test_nominal_anchor_matches_world_contract: expects a NOT YET EXISTING option FrameAligner(start, anchor='nominal') whose align(world) equals compose(start, world) for every world pose and is consistent with the inverse of world.map_to_sim; mark it @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason='fix pending: nominal anchor not implemented'). Do not edit any non-test file. Declare in the result file: tests.cmd = python3 -m pytest -q digital_twin/ws/src/x2_twin_sim/test/test_frame_anchor.py ; files = [{path: digital_twin/ws/src/x2_twin_sim/test/test_frame_anchor.py}].
